name: Villaescusa (Cantabria, Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villaescusa (a tree and a crozier on green, a house).
history: Municipal flag of Villaescusa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villaescusa arms — tree, crozier and house
